advancement_gate.claim_boundary: A passing retrospective result permits a prospective freeze; it does not establish prospective validity.
advancement_gate.primary: Improve study-macro normalized allocation regret over measurement ridge on the primary development suites.
secondary: Do not reduce study-macro pairwise ordering overall.
Report every domain and suite rather than selecting favorable subsets.
Retain real candidate training and held-out evaluation as the verifier.

comparators: small tree ensemble when the training fold has at least eight groups
frozen record-conditioned language-model result on its previously sampled panels

methods.estimator: linear pairwise logistic ranker without an intercept
methods.model_selection: Minimize study-macro normalized allocation regret across the frozen inner grouped folds; break ties toward stronger regularization.
methods.pair_weighting: Each training panel contributes equal total weight, split equally across its non-tied candidate pairs and both pair directions.

protocol.labels: Open labels only for the active fitting partition.
protocol.prediction_receipt: Write and hash every outer-fold prediction before scoring it.
protocol.retrieval: Any retrieved history is exactly the active fitting partition.
protocol.splits: Use DOMAIN_AWARE_NESTED_SPLITS.json without modifying its outer or inner groups.

status: frozen before fitting or scoring the pairwise rankers
